title: Lease Term Agreement Program Schedule — Term Lengths and Program Rent Adjustments
content:
Every Lease Term Agreement is written on one of six term programs. This schedule gives, for each program, the whole number of months a term may be written for, the rent adjustment that prices the program against the 12-month rate of the apartment home, the smallest monthly premium a premium program charges, and the calendar rules that fix a term's dates.

## Schedule A — term length and program rent adjustment

| Term program | Shortest term (months) | Longest term (months) | Rent adjustment to the 12-month rate | Minimum monthly premium |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 1 | 1 | premium of 25 percent (0.25) | 200.00 dollars |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 3 | 5 | premium of 15 percent (0.15) | 150.00 dollars |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 6 | 9 | premium of 8 percent (0.08) | 75.00 dollars |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 10 | 12 | none (0.00) | 0.00 dollars |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 13 | 15 | discount of 1 percent (-0.01) | 0.00 dollars |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 16 | 24 | discount of 2 percent (-0.02) | 0.00 dollars |

A premium is a positive adjustment and a discount a negative one; the minimum monthly premium matters only for a program whose adjustment is a premium. A month-to-month agreement runs one month at a time.

## Schedule B — dates of a term (identical for all six programs)

| Rule | Month-to-Month | Short-Term | Flexible | Standard | Extended | Long-Term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| End date of a term | day before the anniversary | day before the anniversary | day before the anniversary | day before the anniversary | day before the anniversary | day before the anniversary |
| Start of a renewal term | day after the current end date | day after the current end date | day after the current end date | day after the current end date | day after the current end date | day after the current end date |
| Longest wait from lease approval to the start of a new-lease term | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |

"Day before the anniversary" means the term ends on the day before the same day number falling the term's number of months after its start date, and on the last day of the month where that day number does not exist. "Day after the current end date" means a renewal term begins on the day after the expiring term's end date.

## Reading the schedule — worked examples (hypothetical dates)

- A Standard Lease (10-12 Months) term of 12 months starting on a hypothetical 15 March ends on 14 March of the following year.
- A Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) term of 6 months starting on a hypothetical 31 August: the same day number six months later would be 31 February, which does not exist, so the anniversary falls back to the last day of February and the term ends on the day before it.
- A term of 11 months on the Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) program cannot be written: 11 lies above that program's longest term of 9 months. The same 11 months lies within the Standard Lease (10-12 Months) range of 10 to 12.
